capability.scope: Explicit initialization, exact selected-song Trash/restore, inventory sync, custom pack create/rename/add/remove/move, and scoped membership Undo; no pack cascade/purge

response.membership_undo: null | {operation_id,action:remove_memberships|move_memberships,selected_count,source_pack:pack_ref,destination_pack:null|pack_ref,can_undo:boolean}; newest non-undone changed membership operation; retained after restart

request.collection_id: optional null | collection-32hex; filters song membership, forbidden with view packs

response.rows: song_row[] for active/trash; pack_row[] for packs including empty packs

request.action: trash_songs | restore_songs | create_pack | rename_pack | add_memberships | remove_memberships | move_memberships | undo_memberships
request.edition_ids: nonempty exact edition ID array <=1024 for song/add/remove/move actions; empty for create/rename/undo. Total added+removed edges <=1024; moves adding every destination edge allow <=512 songs
request.trash_operation_id: null/absent except required original operation-32hex for restore_songs
request.collection_id: optional null; exact active custom pack ID for rename/add/remove, custom source for move; absent/null for Undo
request.name: optional null; required 1..256 UTF-8 bytes, nonblank, no control characters for create_pack/rename_pack
request.destination_collection_id: optional null; exact active custom destination required only for move_memberships
request.membership_operation_id: optional null; required original changed remove/move operation ID only for undo_memberships

request.preview: exact core_preview object from preview response

response.preview: core_preview, action.type=adopt_inventory; inventory is host-verified bounded delta

song_row.title: literal text
song_row.packs: pack_ref[]; historical imported references without kind remain readable

request.action: {type:trash_songs,song_ids:[edition_id]} OR {type:restore,trash_operation_id:operation_id,entities:[{kind:song,id:edition_id}],memberships:[]} OR {type:adopt_inventory,inventory:<host delta; resend unchanged>} OR {type:create_pack,pack_id:<host allocated collection ID>,name} OR {type:rename_pack,pack_id,name} OR {type:add_memberships,pack_id,song_ids:[edition_id]} OR {type:remove_memberships,pack_id,song_ids:[edition_id]} OR {type:move_memberships,from_pack,to_pack,song_ids:[edition_id]} OR {type:undo_memberships,membership_operation_id:operation_id}

effects.removed_membership_snapshots: [{id:{pack:collection-id,song:edition-id},position:uint,added_at_unix_ms:uint,revision:uint}]; sorted exact removed before-edges for remove/move only, omitted when empty; resend unchanged

effect_summary.selected_count: uint; Undo counts only unique originally changed songs
effect_summary.affected_packs: [{...pack_ref,selected_song_count}]; source counts pretransition selected members, add/move destination counts selected input; undo source may be zero before its edges are restored
effect_summary.target_pack: pack_ref for create/rename/add/remove/move/undo including noops; destination for move, original source for undo
effect_summary.noop_membership_count: uint; every membership noop including already_absent and same_pack
effect_summary.source_pack: pack_ref for remove/move/undo; original source with current name
effect_summary.destination_pack: pack_ref for move or undo-move; explicit null for remove or undo-remove
effect_summary.undo_operation_id: original operation_id for changed remove/move; explicit null for their noops; absent on other actions
effect_summary.membership_operation_id: original membership operation ID for Undo only
effect_summary.selected_edition_ids: exact sorted unique songs in original changed-edge union for Undo only; does not include originally no-op absent members

error.code: catalog_invalid_request | catalog_not_initialized | catalog_already_initialized | catalog_stale | catalog_conflict | catalog_in_trash | catalog_not_found | catalog_recovery_required | catalog_capacity | library_busy | library_io | catalog_random_unavailable | catalog_readonly_pack
error.outcome: not_committed | uncertain (present only for a submitted commit/initialize)

rules: All bodies reject unknown/duplicate fields. Renderer sends captured exact edition IDs, never titles, filter result counts, or inferred current-page selection.

Initialization is explicit and separately previewed. Ordinary preview never initializes. Initialization preview is inert and contains only source-to-collection mapping and verified seed/inventory digests. Commit reconstructs/verifies identical seed. After response loss retry the identical initialize preview, never generate a replacement ID.

Initialization retry returns committed current state only when genesis ID and seed digest match, including after later transitions. Partial markers/corrupt journals require recovery; never silently reset.
One restore preview selects songs from exactly one trash_operation_id. Group multiple original operations into separately reviewed commits.

Changing selection invalidates the visible preview; commit must use the frozen preview exactly. Any stale generation/digest requires refresh and new review. Do not replay selection automatically after refresh.

After lost commit response or uncertain outcome retain exact preview and ID, disable new mutation, query operation. Committed => reconcile receipt/current status and refresh. not_committed => explicit retry of same preview is allowed if its generation remains current; do not substitute a new ID. An error means absence is unproved.
Errors from transport/admission without outcome are uncertain for a submitted mutation. Never infer not_committed from HTTP code alone.

Query pagination binds snapshot,view,collection_id,search,limit. Cursor plus refresh invalid; changed cached snapshot rejects stale cursor. Mutations invalidate advisory caches; external changes require explicit Refresh. Query cache never authorizes a commit.
V1 /manage/query retains its import-* IDs; catalog routes separately return collection_id and explicit import_pack_id mapping. No v1 rows acquire collection IDs.

New physical editions created after initialization remain active and catalog_managed:false in this bounded slice. Explicit sync/preview then the ordinary commit adopts only verified new IDs; afterwards they are eligible for Trash. Existing catalog identities remain stable; exact reimport of a trashed edition stays in Trash.
Trash retains every original, payload, backup and history; reclaimed_bytes is zero. Current admitted performance/media remains usable; newly loading a trashed edition requires restore.

No route accepts paths or calls open_default. Custom create/rename/add/remove/move and scoped remove/move Undo are exposed. Imported/source groups are read-only; pack Trash/cascade/generic rollback/permanent delete/payload cleanup/browser-store fallback are not supported.

Sync adopts at most32 new source groups and32 new editions per explicitly reviewed batch, bounded to1024 affected memberships. New editions wait until all proved source dependencies are admitted. Summary remaining_song_count/remaining_source_count are present only for sync. Refresh and explicitly preview/confirm the next batch until both are zero; never automatically commit the remainder.

Create and add are separately reviewed transactions, never an implied atomic combined request. Create IDs are host allocated with operating-system randomness and collision checks against every retained pack. Duplicate add preserves original edge metadata and reports noops.

The pack projection shares snapshot_id with active/trash. Count all active members, including unavailable physical editions; available_song_count alone counts present verified payloads. Empty custom packs remain visible. Read-only import-group counts are not organizational counts.

Existing supported product catalog/journal histories remain v1 without migration; membership Undo adds a new action and optional receipt evidence. New UI gates on supported_operations; historical source references and receipt bytes remain unchanged. Older renderers may reject custom refs (null import_pack_id), fail closed and require a newer app. Do not reset, reseed or rewrite a managed catalog to downgrade.

Omit collection_id from query wire bodies when null so older v1 hosts with deny_unknown_fields still accept unfiltered reads. Send an explicit collection_id only when the new organization capabilities are advertised.

Remove changes only selected custom-pack edges. Absent members are already_absent noops. Move requires every selected source edge, adds only missing destination edges, then removes source edges in one journal generation. Same source/destination is an explicit same_pack noop. Existing destination edges retain their exact metadata; all other pack references remain unchanged.

Undo names one original changed remove/move operation. It restores only captured removed edges with original position/timestamp and a new revision, and removes only destination edges actually added by that move. The inverse is not itself undoable; all-noop originals and a second new-ID Undo conflict. Same-ID replay still returns its original receipt.

Undo rejects intervening mutations to originally changed membership edges, including remove/re-add cycles, and intervening Trash/restore of their songs/packs. Unrelated pack rename, other-song add/removal, and changes to preexisting destination edges that the original move never changed are preserved. Preview/commit still bind the current complete generation/digest and verify physical availability.

Status exposes only the latest non-undone changed remove/move, including can_undo:false after conflicting work. It is reconstructed from durable receipts; absence of browser state does not erase it. can_undo reflects catalog dependencies, while preview also verifies physical payload availability.

Prior supported product receipt bytes remain unchanged: the new removed_membership_snapshots field is omitted when empty. New remove/move history and undo_memberships require this application or newer; older readers fail closed on unknown evidence/action. Preserve catalog and backups, upgrade the app, and never reset/reseed/rewrite history to downgrade.

pack_ref.import_pack_id: import-64hex for imported; null for custom
pack_ref.name: literal text; imported original names may be <=1024 UTF-8 bytes

pack_row.active_song_count: active member editions including unavailable retained payloads
pack_row.available_song_count: active member editions with verified present payloads
pack_row.shared_song_count: active members also belonging to another catalog pack; source groups count as another pack
